crew.overview: The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.
crew.title: The Worst Person in the World

crew.overview: Upstanding community leader Nils has just won an award for "Citizen of the Year" when he learns the news that his son has died of a heroin overdose. Suspecting foul play, Nils begins to investigate, and soon finds himself at the center of an escalating underworld gang war between Serbian drug dealers and a sociopathic criminal mastermind known only as “The Count.”
crew.title: In Order of Disappearance

details.biography: Throughout an entire life in the film industry, Roy Fenstad has a unique experience base. He has worked in the vast majority of professional functions in the field of sound, and has established himself as one of Norway's best foley artists in recent years.
details.name: Roy Fenstad
